candidate_contract.identity_note: combine with the already-recorded parent-scoped delegated identity; no provider account/thread ids
candidate_contract.owner_system_prompt: in-memory exact string only; required for owner; forbidden for engineer
candidate_contract.persistence: never persist/log plaintext owner prompt; if identity needs it, persist only SHA-256 fingerprint

limits: No hosted CI, Cloudflare, Windows, production, real user data or secrets.
observed_gap: Notion DelegationRequest/DelegationContext carries task/parent/conversation/objective/max-turns but no prompt mode and no owner system prompt.
Notion delegated child runtime builders do not accept a prompt-policy argument.
Qwen coding-subagent defaults missing mode to engineer and requires ownerSystemPrompt for owner mode.
Therefore owner-mode semantics cannot cross the current provider-neutral delegation envelope without an undocumented side channel.

checks: exact owner prompt preserved byte-for-byte including surrounding whitespace/newlines
engineer with owner prompt rejected to avoid ambiguous policy
stable content-free fingerprint for same prompt
evidence output contains no plaintext prompt

risk: A delegated child of an owner-mode parent can silently run under engineer mode or lose the exact private owner prompt, violating the two-mode product invariant. A future Qwen adapter would inherit this mismatch.
